maxwell.title: First Contact Physiotherapist
maxwell.bio: Louis Maxwell is an HCPC-registered physiotherapist (PH128483) with NHS musculoskeletal experience. He is Operations Director of Living With Arthritis (registered charity 1218461) and reviews clinical content where a recorded review date is shown. Content is educational and does not replace a personal assessment.
